name: Personalized Tablecloth
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from 100% premium polyester fabric, this personalized tablecloth is soft, lightweight, and durable for long-lasting use. 
  • The water-resistant surface helps protect your table from spills and stains, while the reinforced edge stitching enhances durability and gives the tablecloth a neat, polished look.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Designed to fit a variety of rectangular tables, the tablecloth measures approximately 107.87 in x 53.94 in (274 cm x 137 cm). 
  • Its generous size provides excellent table coverage for dining tables, buffet setups, party tables, and outdoor gatherings.

 

Printing Technology:
  • Featuring sublimation printing technology, the design is printed with vibrant colors and sharp details for a bold, eye-catching appearance. 
  • The fade-resistant printing ensures your personalized artwork stays bright and beautiful even after repeated use.

 

Functionality Use:

Perfect for both indoor and outdoor occasions, this tablecloth helps protect table surfaces from scratches, spills. Ideal for family dinners, birthday parties, patriotic celebrations, picnics, BBQs, holiday events, and special gatherings, it adds a personalized decorative touch to any space.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized tablecloth makes a thoughtful and practical gift for family members, friends, coworkers, or loved ones. Suitable for birthdays, housewarmings, holidays, anniversaries, family reunions, Independence Day celebrations, and many other special occasions.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Tablecloth
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
